name: TurfSpot — Sports Venue Booking Platform
tagline: Odoo ERP-based sports venue booking — Odoo Hackathon 2025 Top 78 / 19,000+
purpose: A sports venue booking platform built on Odoo ERP with custom modules for real-time slot availability, booking management, and payment integration.
problem_solved: Sports facility owners manage bookings via phone calls and manual ledgers. TurfSpot digitizes the entire booking process with real-time availability, online payments, and automated confirmation.

architecture.description: Built on Odoo ERP with custom Python modules extending Odoo's core. Custom booking logic handles slot availability, conflict detection, and payment processing. React frontend provides a consumer-friendly booking experience separate from Odoo admin.
key_design_choices: Odoo ERP for built-in accounting, CRM, and inventory management
Custom Odoo module architecture for platform-specific booking logic
Real-time slot conflict detection with database-level locking
Separate React consumer UI from Odoo admin interface

key_achievements: Custom Odoo module built from scratch in 48-hour hackathon
Real-time slot availability with conflict-free booking
Payment integration with automated confirmation workflow
Multi-venue support with admin management dashboard

engineering_decisions.decision: Why Odoo ERP over custom backend?
engineering_decisions.reason: Odoo provides built-in accounting, CRM, inventory, and reporting out-of-the-box. A sports venue business needs these modules. Building them from scratch in a 48-hour hackathon is not feasible. Odoo provides the foundation; custom modules add the platform-specific logic.

Odoo's default UI is optimized for business admins — not for consumer booking experiences. A separate React frontend provides a clean, mobile-friendly booking flow for end customers while Odoo handles all backend business logic.

challenges: Learning Odoo module architecture from scratch in 48 hours — solved by studying Odoo documentation and existing module examples
Slot conflict detection under concurrent bookings — solved with PostgreSQL row-level locking
Odoo XML view customization complexity — solved with careful template inheritance
